scan.description: The delegated Harmonic radar scenario should produce stable finite returns in the AVZ static map.

points.description: Finite radar points should be present in front of the radar with a stable x midpoint.

image.description: Harmonic-native radar-physics polar image (radarays_embree_sensor_system): multi-bounce Fresnel reflection/refraction, cone-sampled beams, signal denoising, ambient noise. There should be a strong return in the center column near the range of the nearest AVZ geometry (rows 5-20, ~0.5-2.0m) -- not necessarily the single global peak, since a legitimate secondary bounce (multi-reflection recording is on by default) can reasonably reach a comparable or higher value elsewhere in the column.
